# Documentation Instructions

Documentation is part of the implementation.

Implementation is not complete until documentation is updated.

---

# Architecture Changes

If module responsibilities change:

Update:

- ARCHITECTURE.md

---

# RL Changes

If observation space changes

Update:

- RL_DESIGN.md

If reward function changes

Update:

- RL_DESIGN.md
- reward_function.md

---

# Progress Tracking

When tasks finish:

Update:

- PROGRESS.md
- TASK_BOARD.md

---

# Design Decisions

Record long-term design decisions in:

- DECISIONS.md

---

# Experiments

Whenever PPO configuration changes:

Update:

- EXPERIMENT_LOG.md

---

# Bugs

Whenever issues are discovered:

Update:

- KNOWN_ISSUES.md

---

# Presentation Documentation

Whenever implementation changes user-visible behavior:

Update the appropriate file under:

docs/

---

# README

If setup instructions change:

Update README.md

---

# Synchronization Rule

Documentation should never lag behind implementation.
